paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 141b: he conveyed ownership of the produce of his dovecote to Rav Yehudah. Rav Yehudah went before Mar Shmuel, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The produce of a dovecote is its young birds. The source says Levi conveyed ownership to Rav Yehudah, who then went before Shmuel; it does not mention fruit vendors.

The whole selected Davidson Chullin 141b paragraph has Levi bar Simon conveying the produce of his dovecote to Rav Yehudah, who then comes before Shmuel. This supports the supplied subject and direction; Hyman’s Mar Shmuel honorific is retained. The literal supplied prefix ש- remains a source feature, and the earlier mixed note about the young birds remains verbatim. No fruit vendors, extra legal cases, or identity binding are introduced.
